EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerEnableTickProfile
EnumProperty.Description: Shared by Common and the client, for every configuration. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerBetaLabel
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game: draws the 'Beta 2' label in the top-left corner of every frame (FREELANCER_BETA_LABEL, client only). After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerWidescreenSupport
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game: display modes wider than 4:3 in the options, Hor+ cameras and HUD windows at the screen edges (FREELANCER_WIDESCREEN_SUPPORT, client only). Off builds the retail 4:3-only behaviour. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerRp9
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game: builds RP9.dll (the Direct3D 9 mirror of RP8, needs the DirectX SDK June 2010) and the client's Direct3D 9 extension hooks such as the volumetric nebula (FREELANCER_RP9). Select it at run time with DirectX9 in bin\DACOM.INI. Off builds neither. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerWalkMode
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game: walking through base rooms as Trent (FREELANCER_WALK_MODE, client only; docs/walk_mode.md). Off builds the retail base screens. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.
